status.notes: Reappointment Notice to the Bar records his term expiring 14 July 2021 and a merit selection panel convened for a new eight-year term, so the current term runs to 14 July 2029. LAW SCHOOL UNRESOLVED. The St. John's attribution traces to the prior report's narrative and to a blocked commercial-AI source. Ballotpedia and a New Jersey Law Journal biographical entry both give Seton Hall (J.D. 1986), with Notre Dame, B.B.A. 1983. The NJLJ-derived page also states that a President nominated him, which is wrong for a magistrate judge, so it is not reliable enough to close the question. Omit the law school from the published page until the court or chambers confirms it.
